items.issue: Dates, names, rankings, educational history, childhood, career and authorship are narrated without a source list, while ASR corrupts key names.
items.disposition: Verify against dated primary publications, archives and first-party accounts before factual integration or exact naming.

items.issue: The source alleges lease transfer, theft of customer lists and course materials, deceptive company naming and large financial success.
items.disposition: Require contracts, corporate records, contemporaneous documents and responses from the named parties; otherwise retain only as attributed allegations.

items.issue: It makes identifiable third-party claims about sexual partners, celebrity involvement and sex with a former partner.
items.disposition: Do not state as fact or use as a method example without reliable primary sourcing and privacy-sensitive review.

items.issue: The narrative includes suicidal ideation, antidepressants allegedly administered by a non-clinician, diagnosis/treatment settings and psychiatric hospitalization.
items.disposition: Use authoritative primary sourcing and non-sensational wording; do not infer diagnosis, treatment appropriateness or causality from the montage.

items.issue: Inserted clips and film imagery may be illustrative rather than contemporaneous, and sparse frames cannot prove speaker identity or quote alignment.
items.disposition: Perform continuous review at 660–680 and 1085–1128 seconds and identify original clip sources before attribution.

items.issue: The video uses success stories involving large numbers of women as narrative evidence for methods without consent, selection or outcome records.
items.disposition: Do not treat sexual access or field reports as validated effectiveness evidence; no action-advice permission.

items.issue: Book rankings, category position and RSD financial scale are precise commercial claims without displayed primary documentation.
items.disposition: Verify with contemporaneous publisher, retailer and corporate sources before numerical use.

items.issue: ASR heavily corrupts Mystery, Neil Strauss, Erik von Markovik, Courtney Love, Owen Cook, Herbal, M3 model and English clip text.
items.disposition: Do not quote names or English phrases from ASR alone; listen to original audio and check on-screen text/primary sources.
